mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_auth_feishu_user_org_fact ( user_id, group_ids, department_ids, employment_status, synced_at, last_error_code ) VALUES ( #{userId}, CAST(#{groupsJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{departmentsJson} AS JSON), #{status}, NOW(3), NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE group_ids = VALUES(group_ids), department_ids = VALUES(department_ids), employment_status = VALUES(employment_status), synced_at = VALUES(synced_at), last_error_code = NULL

INSERT INTO t_auth_feishu_user_org_fact ( user_id, group_ids, department_ids, employment_status, synced_at, last_error_code ) VALUES ( #{userId}, JSON_ARRAY(), JSON_ARRAY(), 'UNKNOWN', NOW(3), #{errorCode} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE synced_at = VALUES(synced_at), last_error_code = VALUES(last_error_code)
